program.name: Court Volume
program.subject: Court & field sports
program.blurb: Long court sessions: agility and power one day, reaction work and legs the next.
program.about: The movement court and field sports ask for, in long sessions. One day is an agility circuit of shuffles, cuts and backpedals, then power jumps in straight sets; the other an EMOM of split steps and reactions, then leg strength for cutting. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
program.split: Agility circuit & power sets / reaction EMOM & legs
